record.paper_title: Open problems in Euclidean Ramsey Theory
record.original_question: For every partition of the Euclidean plane E^2 into two color classes C1 and C2, is it true that one of the two classes contains congruent copies of every triangle, with at most one exceptional equilateral triangle that may fail to occur in either class?

evidence.quote: For any partition E^2 = C1 ∪ C2, every triangle occurs
with the possible exception of a single equilateral triangle

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let the Euclidean plane $\mathbb{E}^2$ be partitioned into two color classes $C_1$ and $C_2$ (i.e., $\mathbb{E}^2 = C_1 \cup C_2$ with $C_1 \cap C_2 = \emptyset$). For a triangle $T$ (an ordered or unordered triple of non-collinear points up to congruence), say that $T$ "occurs" in a color class $C_i$ if there exist three points in $C_i$ forming a triangle congruent to $T$.

Prove or disprove: for every such 2-coloring of $\mathbb{E}^2$, there exists at most one triangle $T_0$ — which, if it exists, must be equilateral — such that $T_0$ does not occur in $C_1$ and does not occur in $C_2$; equivalently, every triangle except possibly a single equilateral one occurs monochromatically in some color class.
artifact.status_search_result: The broader Erdős–Graham–Montgomery–Rothschild–Spencer–Straus conjecture (every triangle except equilateral ones is monochromatic under any 2-coloring of the plane) remains open in general; only special cases are known (e.g., 3-term arithmetic progressions, established in 2024). The strengthened "at most one exceptional equilateral triangle" version is a refinement and likewise remains open.

status_evidence.title: Any Two-Coloring of the Plane Contains Monochromatic 3-Term Arithmetic Progressions
status_evidence.snippet: Confirms a special case (collinear 3-term APs) of the Erdős–Graham–Montgomery–Rothschild–Spencer–Straus conjecture; the general triangle conjecture is described as still open.
status_evidence.claim: The general two-color triangle conjecture remains open; only specific configurations have been resolved.

status_evidence.title: Euclidean Ramsey Theory (Graham)
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys the conjecture that every triangle except equilateral is monochromatic in any 2-coloring of the plane, listing it as open.
status_evidence.claim: The triangle conjecture is listed as an open problem in Euclidean Ramsey theory.
